events.title: More Prehistoric Discoveries — A Major Epoch Vault Update
events.summary: Discover more of the prehistoric world From life’s recovery after a mass extinction to the rise of dinosaurs, Epoch Vault now has even more to discover. The full game will feature 79 stages in the Triassic Period, 91 in the Jurassic Period, and 104 in the Cretaceous Period. We’ve refreshed the Codex illustrations, completely rewritten the Cretaceous entries, and improved translations across all 11 supported languages. events.summary: The Triassic and Jurassic archives have been refreshed We’ve made a substantial update to two chapters of Epoch Vault. The texts for both the Triassic and Jurassic periods have been thoroughly proofread, and translations across all supported languages have been revised and improved. More to discover in the Jurassic The Jurassic archive has been expanded with new facts, giving you more to uncover as you explore its creatures and changing world. events.title: Sharks Join the Archive
events.summary: A new Epoch Vault update is here.This update improves performance, adds new nodes — including prehistoric sharks — and gives the Jurassic and Cretaceous trees a visual polish for cleaner, more readable branches.Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback.

events.title: Epoch Vault Expands into the Cretaceous
events.summary: The archive reaches the Cretaceous Development on Epoch Vault has reached its next major milestone. Volume III, devoted to the Cretaceous Period, is now part of the game and will be included in the launch version. After restoring the Jurassic, players will open a new progression tree that follows life from the rise of flowering plants and the last great sauropods through the reign of tyrannosaurs and horned dinosaurs, all the way to the asteroid impact that ended the age of dinosaurs. events.title: Quick patch: faster first Tome
events.summary: A quick follow-up to the last update, based on your feedback:The first Tome (your first "publish") now comes much sooner — less early grind before you unlock the prestige loop, while the mid and late game stay exactly the same.Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming. Steam Next Fest is in October — a wishlist really helps a solo dev! 🦕
